provenance.kind: Project-authored controlled scientific study. All tables are stipulated model observations, not a claim of new experimental or ab-initio results.
provenance.scope: Inference is conditional on the explicit finite model, source identities, units and measurement policy.

graph_convention: Original heavy-atom molecular graph, with every bond treated as one undirected edge regardless of aromaticity/order. For a connected graph independent cycle rank is E-V+1. It is not the number of all simple cycles and is not chosen from an arbitrary ring basis.
cycle_edge_components: An edge is cyclic iff it lies on at least one simple cycle, equivalently iff it is not a graph bridge. Build the subgraph containing ONLY cyclic edges and their endpoint vertices; count connected components. Ignore isolated noncyclic vertices. An articulation in that cyclic-edge graph is an atom whose removal increases its component count; report entries with at least one such atom.
theta_graph_policy: For ONLY the supplied fused_panel and bridged_panel, identify the two degree3 atoms. Their three internally vertex-disjoint paths partition the entire graph; report their edge lengths sorted increasingly. A length1path means the two ring junction atoms share an edge; paths all longer than1 give a bridged arrangement in this finite graph. No arbitrary smallest-ring basis defines these lengths.
scope: Molecular topology interpretation, not ring strain, conformational energy or reactivity inference. Entry labels name bookkeeping roles and do not supply the numerical graph invariants.
